newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stocks end lunar year up and optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stocks end lunar year up and optimistic.

text.p: Shenzhen's B shares posted a solid gain on Friday, ending the old Chinese lunar year on a strong note in anticipation of a bullish year ahead, brokers said.

By the end of the last session before the two-week Chinese Lunar New Year holiday, the B share index rose 2.60 points or 1.68 percent to 157.06 on heavy turnover of HK$218.47 million, compared with Thursday's HK$119.13 million.
"Investors were optimistic about most firms' 1996 results, many of which are expected to be released soon after the holiday," a broker said.
Most listed firms benefited from China's two cuts in bank interest rates last year, brokers said.
The A share index gained 0.19 points or 0.05 percent to end at 372.54 on turnover of 7.09 billion yuan against the previous session's 6.64 billion.

Southern Glass, the strongest performer in the B share market, was the most active counter on volume of 3.67 million shares and rose HK$0.28 or 5.89 percent to HK$5.03. The rise was due in part to expectations that a 1.2-billion-yuan float glass project would bring it substantial profits, brokers said.
Jiangling Motors was the second biggest gainer and added HK$0.17 or five percent to HK$3.57 on trade of 868,350 shares.

Brokers said they expected the company to report sharply higher earnings for 1996 because U.S. giant Ford Co spent around US$40 million buying 80 percent of Jiangling's 174 million B shares in 1995 and introduced new technology to its plant.
Lizhu Pharmaceutical put on HK$0.25 to HK$5.69 on trade of 1.59 million shares on institutional buying.
Guangdong Power firmed HK$0.12 to HK$7.20 with the day's second heaviest trade of 2.7 million shares.
Hainan Pearl River dipped HK$0.05 or 1.28 percent to HK$3.85 on two million shares on profit-taking, brokers said.

The A share market saw a marginal rise, with investor confidence strengthened by institutional buying in market giant Shenzhen Development Bank, brokers said. The counter advanced 0.26 yuan to 19.24 yuan on 27.15 million shares.

Inner Mongolia Yuanxing Natural Soda Co Ltd, which listed 58.5 million A shares in Shenzhen on Friday, ended the session at 11.70 yuan compared with an offer price of 5.11 yuan earlier this month. Volume was a heavy 41 million shares.
